title: "FLT3LKO and IL7KO multiome: QC downstream-use selection"
subtitle: "All cells retained; analysis-universe eligibility marked by user-selected thresholds"
output:
  github_document:
    toc: true
params:
  selection_dir: null
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 6, dpi = 160)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(data.table); library(ggplot2); library(jsonlite); library(knitr) })
root <- normalizePath(params$selection_dir, mustWork = TRUE)
selection <- fread(cmd = paste("gzip -cd", shQuote(file.path(root, "cell_qc_selection.tsv.gz"))))
sample_summary <- fread(file.path(root, "sample_selection_summary.tsv"))
criterion_summary <- fread(file.path(root, "criterion_selection_summary.tsv"))
thresholds <- fromJSON(file.path(root, "thresholds.json"), simplifyVector = FALSE)
validation <- fromJSON(file.path(root, "validation.json"), simplifyVector = TRUE)
sample_levels <- c("FLT3LKO_BM_WT", "FLT3LKO_BM_KO", "IL7KO_BM_WT", "IL7KO_BM_KO")
sample_summary[, library_id := factor(library_id, levels = sample_levels)]
setorder(sample_summary, library_id)
criterion_labels <- c(
  pass_rna_umi_gt_1000 = "RNA UMI > 1,000",
  pass_genes_gt_500 = "Detected genes > 500",
  pass_mito_lt_20 = "Mitochondrial RNA < 20%",
  pass_atac_fragments_gt_1000 = "ATAC fragments > 1,000",
  pass_tss_gt_2 = "TSS enrichment > 2",
  pass_nucleosome_lt_2 = "Nucleosome signal < 2"
)
sample_colors <- c(FLT3LKO_BM_WT = "#4E79A7", FLT3LKO_BM_KO = "#E15759", IL7KO_BM_WT = "#59A14F", IL7KO_BM_KO = "#B07AA1")
```

# Selection rule

All `r format(validation$input_cells, big.mark = ",")` cells remain present. A cell is marked `qc_use_downstream = TRUE` only when all six strict criteria are satisfied:

1. RNA UMI > 1,000
2. detected genes > 500
3. mitochondrial RNA percentage < 20
4. ATAC fragments > 1,000
5. TSS enrichment > 2
6. nucleosome signal < 2

Cells failing any criterion are marked `retained_not_selected`; they were not deleted.

# Downstream analysis universe

```{r sample-table}
display <- sample_summary[, .(
  Library = library_id, Target = knockout_target, Genotype = genotype,
  `All retained` = cells_retained, `Use downstream` = cells_use_downstream,
  `Retained, not selected` = cells_retained_not_selected,
  `Use downstream (%)` = round(percent_use_downstream, 1)
)]
kable(display, format = "pipe")
```

```{r selection-bars}
plot_data <- melt(
  sample_summary,
  id.vars = "library_id",
  measure.vars = c("cells_use_downstream", "cells_retained_not_selected"),
  variable.name = "status", value.name = "cells"
)
plot_data[, status := factor(
  status,
  levels = c("cells_use_downstream", "cells_retained_not_selected"),
  labels = c("Use downstream", "Retained, not selected")
)]
ggplot(plot_data, aes(library_id, cells, fill = status)) +
  geom_col(position = "fill", width = 0.75) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent()) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Use downstream" = "#3B8C6E", "Retained, not selected" = "#D9D9D9")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Fraction of retained cells", fill = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

# Criterion-level results

```{r criteria-table}
criterion_display <- criterion_summary[library_id != "ALL"]
criterion_display[, library_id := factor(library_id, levels = sample_levels)]
criterion_display[, Criterion := unname(criterion_labels[criterion])]
setorder(criterion_display, criterion, library_id)
kable(
  criterion_display[, .(
    Library = library_id, Criterion, Pass = cells_pass, Fail = cells_fail,
    `Pass (%)` = round(percent_pass, 1)
  )],
  format = "pipe"
)
```

```{r failure-plot}
criterion_display[, fail_percent := 100 - percent_pass]
ggplot(criterion_display, aes(Criterion, fail_percent, fill = library_id)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.72) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = sample_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Cells failing criterion (%)", fill = "Library") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "bottom")
```

# Retained artifacts and validation

The complete `cell_qc_selection.tsv.gz` contains one row for every input cell, the six criterion flags, the combined downstream-use flag, and semicolon-separated failure reasons. `downstream_cell_ids.txt` defines the future analysis-universe cell set; `retained_not_selected_cell_ids.txt` records its complement.

```{r validation-table}
checks <- data.frame(
  Check = c(
    "Physical cell filtering performed", "Input cells", "Rows retained",
    "Unique cell IDs", "Cells marked for downstream use",
    "Cells retained but not selected", "Partition complete", "Cell order preserved",
    "Missing combined selection flags"
  ),
  Value = c(
    as.character(validation$physical_cell_filtering_performed),
    format(validation$input_cells, big.mark = ","), format(validation$retained_rows, big.mark = ","),
    format(validation$unique_cell_ids, big.mark = ","), format(validation$cells_use_downstream, big.mark = ","),
    format(validation$cells_retained_not_selected, big.mark = ","),
    as.character(validation$partition_is_complete), as.character(validation$cell_order_preserved),
    validation$missing_selection_flags
  )
)
kable(checks, format = "pipe")
```

The selection is a staging artifact. When the scWorkbench source bundle is created, all cells will be imported, and `qc_use_downstream = TRUE` will become the explicit accepted analysis-universe cell set.
